description: This file defines utility classes, error handling, and provider registry mechanisms for Firebolt integration, including JSON request/response containers, error utilities, and provider management.

classes.name: JListenRequest
classes.description: JSON container for listen request with a boolean 'listen' field.

classes.name: JListenResponse
classes.description: JSON container for listen response with 'event' string and 'listening' boolean.

classes.name: ProviderInfo
classes.description: Structure holding provider connection info with channelId and requestId.

classes.name: ProviderRegistry
classes.description: Thread-safe registry managing provider info mapped by string keys.

classes.name: ResponseUtils
classes.description: Utility class for setting null responses on success.

classes.name: ErrorUtils
classes.description: Utility class for generating error messages and Firebolt-specific errors.

methods.name: ProviderInfo::create
methods.description: Static method to create ProviderInfo with specified channelId and requestId.

methods.name: ProviderRegistry::Add
methods.description: Adds provider info to registry by key, with overload for direct ProviderInfo.

methods.name: ProviderRegistry::Remove
methods.description: Removes provider info from registry by key.

methods.name: ProviderRegistry::CleanupByConnectionId
methods.description: Removes all provider entries matching a specific connection ID.

methods.name: ResponseUtils::SetNullResponseForSuccess
methods.description: Sets result to 'null' if hResult indicates success and result is empty.

methods.name: ErrorUtils::GetErrorMessageForFrameworkErrors
methods.description: Generates JSON-RPC error message string for given error code and message.

methods.name: ErrorUtils::GetFireboltError
methods.description: Returns error message string based on FireboltError enum.

methods.name: ErrorUtils::NotSupported
methods.description: Sets resolution string to 'NotSupported' error message.

methods.name: ErrorUtils::NotAvailable
methods.description: Sets resolution string to 'NotAvailable' error message.

methods.name: ErrorUtils::NotPermitted
methods.description: Sets resolution string to 'NotPermitted' error message.

methods.name: ErrorUtils::CustomInitialize
methods.description: Sets resolution to a general error message with custom message.

methods.name: ErrorUtils::CustomInternal
methods.description: Sets resolution to an internal error message with custom message.

methods.name: ErrorUtils::CustomBadRequest
methods.description: Sets resolution to a bad request error message with custom message.

methods.name: ErrorUtils::CustomBadMethod
methods.description: Sets resolution to a bad method error message with custom message.
